No deviations from plan scope; both remaining beads (workspace-htgw header restructure, workspace-jzul Files tab) implemented, committed per-bead, pushed. All 9 pan-1232 beads now closed. Full frontend suite green (189 files / 1756 tests), frontend tsc + eslint clean.

Verified deviations from bead wording (root-cause, not bandaids — all documented in commit bodies):

1. Branch field. The header bead said activeAgent.branchName, but no branchName field exists on the Agent type. The branch lives at agent.git?.branch (GitStatus.branch) — how every other frontend surface reads it (CommandPalette, GodView/AgentCard, FocusView). Used the verified-correct field.

2. Radius token. Header AC6 named var(--radius-md), but that CSS variable is undefined in the codebase (only --radius and --radius-sm exist as CSS vars; --radius-lg is referenced elsewhere but also resolves to nothing). The medium radius lives in the Tailwind theme (tailwind.config.js: md = calc(var(--radius) - 2px)), so the branch chip uses rounded-md — the working medium-radius primitive matching the AC's intent.

3. formatSpend reused by exporting it from DrawerActiveAgent (bead's first-listed option) instead of duplicating.

4. Files tab. DiffPanel has no 'files-only'/'compact' CONTENT mode (its modes are layout-only inline|sheet|sidebar), so the full inline DiffPanel is rendered per the bead's 'otherwise render the full DiffPanel'. DiffPanel is agent-scoped (it calls /api/agents/:id/diffs), so the Files tab scopes to the issue's canonical work agent via pickDefaultDrawerAgent — no new server endpoint added (AC4). Added an initial-fetch 'Loading files…' gate mirroring the standalone diff popout to avoid a misleading 'No completed turns yet' flash.

Minor: commitlint emits a non-blocking scope-enum warning (scope 'drawer' vs allowed list) on both commits; commits landed fine. Amending is forbidden, so left as-is.

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Files tab defaults to checkpoint diffs instead of branch-vs-main — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:208`
Inline `DiffPanel` now renders without `?diff=1`, but `DrawerFilesPanel` mounts it without selecting `vs-main`. With no URL `diffTurnId`, `DiffPanel` keeps `selectedTurnId === null` and selects `/api/agents/:id/diffs/full` instead of `/api/agents/:id/diffs/vs-main`. That means opening the drawer Files tab can show checkpoint/full-thread files instead of the current branch diff, or show "No completed turns yet" when there are no checkpoint summaries even though the workspace has branch changes. The Files tab needs to initialize `DiffPanel` in branch-vs-main mode and preserve that path when summaries are empty.

### [requirements] Files tab does not render `DiffPanel` for a workspace branch unless an agent id is also present — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:197`
Scope: in_pr_scope. AC-34 requires `drawer.tab === 'files'` plus an existing workspace branch to render `DiffPanel` scoped to `feature/<issue-id>` vs `main`. `DrawerFilesPanel` still requires `agentId` in addition to `workspace.exists`; when the workspace exists but no agent id is available, it renders "No agent session for this workspace yet." instead of the required `DiffPanel`.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [performance] Avoid deriving the full activity list twice for the Activity tab — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:44`
`DrawerActivityPanel()` calls `useDrawerData()` for `activityFull` while `IssueDrawer()` already calls `useDrawerData()` for the same issue. This repeats the uncapped activity filtering/mapping/sorting on the Activity tab. The performance reviewer classified it as acceptable to proceed, with a recommendation to pass `activityFull` from the parent drawer instead.

### [requirements] Changed low-risk support files have no mapped requirement
The requirements reviewer noted that `scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh` and `src/dashboard/frontend/src/index.css` are in the changed-file set, but no acceptance criterion, trace item, non-goal, or stub finding in the manifest maps to their behavior.

### [advisory] CodeRabbit nitpick
CodeRabbit suggested reusing the shared `isActiveAgent` helper in `IssueDrawer.tsx` instead of duplicating the active-agent predicate. This was advisory and non-gating in the review context.

## Scope Note
The immediately previous review directory, `agent-pan-1232-review-3f5fd283`, has no `synthesis.md`, so this synthesis uses the last completed review (`63ca56ef19fe0c3530a5a1b1f9ebb0f05fff5c6a`) as the durable prior cycle for convergence. Both blocking Files-tab findings are on frontend drawer/diff code changed since that completed synthesis.
